CustomField.description: TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036. Converted in place from a writable Currency placeholder to a Roll-Up Summary: SUM of QuoteLineItem.ELV_ARR_Amount__c filtered on ELV_Include_in_Exit_ARR__c = true. Verbatim port of CPQ SBQQ__Quote__c.Exit_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c, which is SUM of SBQQ__QuoteLine__c.ARR_Amount__c filtered on Include_in_Exit_ARR__c = True - same operation, same summarized field, same filter. Eligible only because ELV_ARR_Amount__c was repointed off Product2.Exclude_from_ARR__c onto the line-local stamp; a roll-up cannot summarize a cross-object formula. Include in Exit ARR is a MANUAL user input overriding exclusions (Lawrence Medina, 2026-08-19), so it is intentionally a stored checkbox with no automation and ELV_ExitARRHelper must NOT be wired to a trigger. PRE-FLIGHT: reproduced all 20 stored values to the cent, totals 4,455,619.45 both sides.
